OfficeCategory.OFFICE_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION:
The county treasurer is a constitutional officer, elected by vote of the county at large for a term of four years, but prohibited from serving more than two terms within 12 years, except for time filling an unexpired term   
The county treasurer collects, retains custody of and disburses county funds. The treasurer collects delinquent taxes, and collects local and state general property taxes for all units in the county. The treasurer is required to annually send each person charged with taxes a statement of the amount of property tax owed.
